1.0: #h0#, I've been told you've become this city's #bCitizen of Honor#k. Do you understand what that means? Heh... it's no mere title. It means everyone in this city, myself included, has come to see you as someone we can trust. Trust is something no amount of money can buy. So... I suppose congratulations are in order.
